frontMatter.title: Big Wins, Finals Secured & A Huge Week Ahead
frontMatter.summary: Grade 2 Ladies 'A' and Grade 2 Mens recorded 4–0 wins to secure League Final and Semi-Final spots, while Grade 6 Mens reached the Cup Final. A huge week follows with the final league games, Doubles Quarter-Finals, and Cup Semi-Finals. No club night this Wednesday due to MBA Quarter-Finals in Claremont Stadium.
